description: Synthetic broken-power-law cosmic-ray flux for cr_spectrum_powerlaw_fit.py. Generated exactly from index 2.7 below and 3.1 above a break at 4e15 eV (illustrative of a 'knee'-like feature; see references/32-cosmic-ray-spectrum-and-composition.md), with no added scatter, so a segmented fit recovers both indices and the index change to numerical precision. Illustrative only - not a measurement of any real spectrum.

units.flux: arbitrary units, m^-2 sr^-1 s^-1 eV^-1 convention
